Record Class Click

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.trevlar.menukit.core.Click
Record Components:
button - GLFW mouse button index (0 left, 1 right, 2 middle, ...)
shift - shift held
ctrl - control (command on macOS) held
alt - alt/option held
public record Click(int button, boolean shift, boolean ctrl, boolean alt) extends Record
A mouse click as seen by a PanelElement: which button, plus the modifier keys held at the moment the click was dispatched.

Handed to Button.onSecondaryClick / Toggle.onSecondaryClick handlers so one handler can branch on right, middle, and shift+right without three separate hooks. The modifier state is sampled from GLFW when the click reaches the element; PanelElement.mouseClicked(double, double, int) carries only the button index, and dispatch is synchronous inside the input callback, so this is the state at the moment the player clicked. (26.2 dropped the static Screen.hasShiftDown() helpers, hence the direct key poll.)
